G-CITATION-CHECKED.reads: the citation check`s bank (the gate step at step zero): every cite checked, the two misses raised as prompts and answered, none repaired silently, before Component 1

G-ROWGEN-STEPZERO.reads: the rowgen bank: constellation and the build-free diff over the 19 roster tables, both exit 0 (b670 rules row 3)

G-DELETES-ONE-BRANCH.reads: the command capture by the record tool`s reader and the command bank: each branch delete naming one branch, no glob and no variable in any half, nothing chained after (data/b694_rules.txt row (1)), the ruling`s nine exactly

G-ANSWERS-CHECKED.reads: the citation bank`s mid-act prints read at HEAD, each before the step its answer governs

G-SCORER-READS-BANKS.reads: tools/b696_record.py`s code, prose stripped: the N1-N4 scorers reading banks and commits and no ledger, the scores bank written once, the entry`s scores line from it

G-ENTRY-TITLE-FORM.reads: FINDINGS at the findings bank`s line and the record tool`s title from the witness and arm banks: the ferry`s form adjusted to what the act did

G-ARM-REPAIRED.reads: the arm bank, its json`s HEAD against tools/rule_arms.py now, and the tool`s CONTROLS: the repaired arm run at a HEAD carrying it, five cases as wanted, the shared tool sealed ((R306)(2))

G-SOURCE-BANKED.reads: the DLMF source bank and the step-zero commit: the page`s sha256, (5.11.2) and its remainder bound at the lines the plan cites

G-TAILS-PLAN-FIRST.reads: the plan, the answers bank and the witness units` first time: the plan banked at step zero and raised with the options verbatim before any term (N2)

G-TAIL-BALLS-SHRINK.reads: the controls bank`s two-height rows and the witness bank`s premise line: every tail ball shrinking as predicted, P3 the one premise (N3)

G-ZETA-FIRST.reads: the witness json`s units in banked order, the controls bank and the tool`s refusal: the zeta control first and nonnegative at every width, one row per width with both radii (N4)

G-T1-REWORDED.reads: the controls bank: C3 at every cell, T1 as re-worded (the integral over [4000, 8000] inside the ball, the midpoints within the 256-bit ball) and T2

G-FACES-ROW-HELD.reads: the faces-rows bank against b695`s node list at the act`s start and now: the successor drafted with the ruling`s caveat once, the rest equal, nothing written ((R306)(4))

G-READFIRST-DIFF-BANKED.reads: the readfirst diff bank and the step-zero commit, and the hand list`s blob at HEAD against step zero`s: the diff banked, no bank rewritten

G-TOOL-REPAIRS.reads: the repairs bank`s verdict: the one shared-tool repair and the two carried routes, each by the defect or order it answers, no frozen bank edited

G-PARTS-PRERUN.reads: the pre-run bank`s six parts with their seconds, named in the form the parts arm reads

G-ARM-SECONDS-BANKED.reads: the per-arm seconds bank: every standing arm clocked at the pre-run, the three slowest named, each part`s seconds

G-DEFECTS-LETTERED.reads: the defects bank read at HEAD: the sealed letters its prefix, consecutive letters, owners the seat or the navigator

G-BINARY-ROWS-READ.reads: every binary bank from b680 on against a text bank of its act naming its own path and sha256, or its frozen row corrected by a corrigendum: b694`s PNG through row (9), this act`s gz through its hashes bank
